user_query: I want to get a list of the top songs in the world including the song title, artist name, and a link to listen to the song on Shazam.

TaskList.description: Query an API to retrieve the current top songs globally.
For each top song retrieved, extract the song title and artist name.
Query Shazam's API to get the listening link for each song based on the song title and artist name.
Compile the song title, artist name, and corresponding Shazam link into a final list.
